summary: Modular monolith: Django + Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL serving Next.js (web) + React Native (Expo) for Android, hosted on Google Cloud Run (asia-south1 Mumbai). Estimated $110-440/month (around the $150 budget).

architecture_rationale.text: One deployable with strict internal modules for the marketplace domain (e.g. bookings, providers, chat, payments): a 3-engineer team gets clear boundaries without distributed-system overhead; modules can be extracted later if scale demands it. Over-engineering guard: microservices rejected: 3 engineer(s), no DevOps cannot absorb the operational overhead.

frontend.justification: Web - Next.js: Chosen because team already works in javascript (team.languages); server-rendered/pre-rendered HTML for seo_critical=true; shares React/TypeScript skills and code with the React Native (Expo) app; strong time-to-market (4/5) with priorities.time_to_market=5. Mobile - React Native (Expo): Chosen because team already works in javascript (team.languages); strong time-to-market (5/5) with priorities.time_to_market=5; strong cost efficiency (4/5) with priorities.cost=4; strong maintainability (4/5) with priorities.maintainability=3.

alternatives.why_not: Next.js scores higher on platform coverage (fit 9.0 vs 9.5).
React Native scores higher on maintainability and performance (fit 6.8 vs 7.6).

tradeoffs: Feature set is tuned for Vercel; self-hosting needs containers or OpenNext
App Router caching model has a learning curve
Some native modules need custom development builds

backend.justification: Chosen because team already works in python (team.languages); strong time-to-market (5/5) with priorities.time_to_market=5; strong maintainability (5/5) with priorities.maintainability=3; strong security (5/5) with priorities.security=3.

alternatives.why_not: Django scores higher on time-to-market and security (fit 8.3 vs 8.8).

tradeoffs: Sync-first; WebSockets need Channels/ASGI
Heavier conventions for tiny services

warnings.message: To respect priorities.cost=4 the database runs as a single-zone primary with automated backups; single-zone managed SLAs are ~99.5%, below the 99.9% target. Enabling the HA standby roughly doubles the database line item.
Expected $110-440/month: the upper end exceeds the $150 budget at peak usage. Set billing alerts.
CERT-In Directions (2022): keep ICT system logs for 180 days within Indian jurisdiction.
DPDP Act 2023: consent notices, purpose limitation, breach intimation to the Data Protection Board and erasure on request. India residency is enforced because data_residency=india.
